summary: Navitas Semiconductor disclosed an 8-K reporting a September 19, 2026 Stock Purchase Agreement to buy 1,461,988 Magnachip common shares at $3.42 per share, a $5.0 million aggregate private placement (Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D), closing expected on or about September 24, 2026. Magnachip must file an S-3 resale registration within 30 days of closing, targeting effectiveness within 60 days (90 if reviewed). No board recommendation, premium, or advisor is disclosed, and no ownership percentage is stated. Watch resale registration timing and any subsequent stake disclosures or strategic cooperation, given the small size and likely passive-investment framing.
